  Effective timing
    Startup gives the container 5m to come up before the kubelet restarts it.
    Readiness acts after 3 consecutive failures, at worst 15s after the container stops responding. Readiness begins after the startup probe succeeds. Traffic can first arrive 5s after the startup probe succeeds.
